entities.name: Jovan I. Deretić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovan Ilić Deretić was a Serbian publicist and writer. Deretić was an engineer by training but was mainly noted for his pseudohistorical and conspiracy theories. He was the proponent of an alternative history of the Serbs that asserts a larger role in history than described by historians.

entities.name: Jovan I. Deretić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jovan Ilić Deretić was a Serbian publicist and writer. Deretić was an engineer by training but was mainly noted for his pseudohistorical and conspiracy theories. He was the proponent of an alternative history of the Serbs that asserts a larger role in history than described by historians.
